61 |     """
62 |     Interroga il WFS del Catasto per un punto specificato e crea opzionalmente un layer
63 |     Args:
64 |         x (float): Longitudine del punto (WGS84)
65 |         y (float): Latitudine del punto (WGS84)
66 |         create_layer (bool): Se True, crea un layer vettoriale con i risultati
67 |     """
68 |     
69 |     # URL base del servizio WFS catastale con tutti i parametri necessari
70 |     base_url = 'https://wfs.cartografia.agenziaentrate.gov.it/inspire/wfs/owfs01.php'
71 |     
72 |     # Costruzione dell'URI con parametri verificati
73 |     uri = (f"pagingEnabled='true' "
74 |            f"preferCoordinatesForWfsT11='false' "
75 |            f"restrictToRequestBBOX='1' "
76 |            f"srsname='EPSG:6706' "
77 |            f"typename='CP:CadastralParcel' "
78 |            f"url='{base_url}' "
79 |            f"version='2.0.0' "
80 |            f"language='ita'")
81 |     
82 |     print(f"\nInizio query per il punto ({x}, {y})")
83 |     
84 |     # Carica il layer WFS
85 |     wfs_layer = QgsVectorLayer(uri, "catasto_query", "WFS")
86 |     
87 |     if not wfs_layer.isValid():
88 |         error_msg = wfs_layer.dataProvider().error().message() if wfs_layer.dataProvider() else "Nessun dettaglio disponibile"
89 |         raise Exception(f"Layer non valido. Dettagli: {error_msg}")
90 |     
91 |     print("Layer WFS caricato con successo")
92 |     
93 |     # Crea il filtro spaziale
94 |     point = QgsGeometry.fromPointXY(QgsPointXY(x, y))
95 |     
96 |     # Imposta una request con il filtro spaziale
97 |     request = QgsFeatureRequest().setFilterRect(point.boundingBox())
98 |     
99 |     # Recupera le features
100 |     features = list(wfs_layer.getFeatures(request))
101 |     print(f"Features trovate: {len(features)}")
102 |     
103 |     if create_layer and features:
104 |         # Crea un nuovo layer vettoriale in memoria
105 |         memory_layer = QgsVectorLayer("MultiPolygon?crs=EPSG:6706", "Particelle_Catastali", "memory")
106 |         memory_layer.startEditing()
107 |         
108 |         # Aggiungi i campi al layer
109 |         for field in wfs_layer.fields():
110 |             memory_layer.addAttribute(field)
111 |         memory_layer.updateFields()
112 |         
113 |         # Aggiungi le features al nuovo layer
114 |         for feat in features:
115 |             new_feat = QgsFeature(memory_layer.fields())
116 |             # Copia gli attributi
117 |             for field in wfs_layer.fields():
118 |                 new_feat[field.name()] = feat[field.name()]

125 |         # Aggiungi il layer al progetto

128 |         
129 |         return features, memory_layer

75 | 
76 |         buf = self.getParameterValue(self.BUFFER)
77 | 
78 |         writer = self.getOutputFromName(self.OUTPUT).getVectorWriter(layer.fields(), QgsWkbTypes.Polygon,
79 |                                                                      layer.crs(), context)
80 | 
81 |         outFeat = QgsFeature()
82 |         extent = layer.extent()
83 |         extraX = extent.height() * (buf / 100.0)
84 |         extraY = extent.width() * (buf / 100.0)
85 |         height = extent.height()
86 |         width = extent.width()
87 |         c = voronoi.Context()
88 |         pts = []
89 |         ptDict = {}
90 |         ptNdx = -1
91 | 
92 |         features = QgsProcessingUtils.getFeatures(layer, context)
93 |         total = 100.0 / QgsProcessingUtils.featureCount(layer, context)
94 |         for current, inFeat in enumerate(features):
95 |             geom = inFeat.geometry()
96 |             point = geom.asPoint()
97 |             x = point.x() - extent.xMinimum()
98 |             y = point.y() - extent.yMinimum()
99 |             pts.append((x, y))
100 |             ptNdx += 1
101 |             ptDict[ptNdx] = inFeat.id()
102 |             feedback.setProgress(int(current * total))
103 | 
104 |         if len(pts) < 3:
105 |             raise GeoAlgorithmExecutionException(
106 |                 self.tr('Input file should contain at least 3 points. Choose '
107 |                         'another file and try again.'))
108 | 
109 |         uniqueSet = set(item for item in pts)
110 |         ids = [pts.index(item) for item in uniqueSet]
111 |         sl = voronoi.SiteList([voronoi.Site(i[0], i[1], sitenum=j) for (j,
112 |                                                                         i) in enumerate(uniqueSet)])
113 |         voronoi.voronoi(sl, c)
114 |         inFeat = QgsFeature()
115 | 
116 |         current = 0
117 |         if len(c.polygons) == 0:
118 |             raise GeoAlgorithmExecutionException(
119 |                 self.tr('There were no polygons created.'))
120 | 
121 |         total = 100.0 / len(c.polygons)
122 | 
123 |         for (site, edges) in list(c.polygons.items()):
124 |             request = QgsFeatureRequest().setFilterFid(ptDict[ids[site]])
125 |             inFeat = next(layer.getFeatures(request))
126 |             lines = self.clip_voronoi(edges, c, width, height, extent, extraX, extraY)
127 |

129 |             geom = QgsGeometry(geom.convexHull())
130 |             outFeat.setGeometry(geom)
131 |             outFeat.setAttributes(inFeat.attributes())
132 |             writer.addFeature(outFeat)
133 | 
134 |             current += 1

136 | 
137 |         del writer

13 | def build_intersection_memory_layer(layer_a, layer_b):
14 |     """
15 |     Gera uma camada temporária (memory) com a interseção entre duas camadas poligonais.
16 |     Campos: area_m2, area_ha, perim_m
17 |     """
18 |     if not _is_polygon_layer(layer_a) or not _is_polygon_layer(layer_b):
19 |         return None
20 | 
21 |     # Camada temporária "memory" (Cookbook: memory provider via QgsVectorLayer(..., "memory"))
22 |     # :contentReference[oaicite:16]{index=16}
23 |     crs_auth = layer_a.crs().authid()
24 |     out_layer = QgsVectorLayer(f"Polygon?crs={crs_auth}", "intersecao_temp", "memory")
25 |     if not out_layer.isValid():
26 |         return None
27 | 
28 |     pr = out_layer.dataProvider()
29 | 
30 |     # Campos (Cookbook: addAttributes + updateFields)
31 |     # :contentReference[oaicite:17]{index=17}
32 |     pr.addAttributes([
33 |         QgsField("area_m2", QMetaType.Type.Double),
34 |         QgsField("area_ha", QMetaType.Type.Double),
35 |         QgsField("perim_m", QMetaType.Type.Double),
36 |     ])
37 |     out_layer.updateFields()
38 | 
39 |     # Medidas (Cookbook: QgsDistanceArea, setEllipsoid, measurePerimeter/measureArea)
40 |     # :contentReference[oaicite:18]{index=18}
41 |     d = QgsDistanceArea()
42 |     d.setEllipsoid("WGS84")
43 | 
44 |     # Índice espacial da camada B (Cookbook: bulk loading)
45 |     # :contentReference[oaicite:19]{index=19}
46 |     index_b = QgsSpatialIndex(layer_b.getFeatures())
47 | 
48 |     out_feats = []
49 | 
50 |     # Itera features da camada A e usa bbox + spatial index para candidatos em B
51 |     for fa in layer_a.getFeatures():
52 |         ga = fa.geometry()
53 |         if not ga or ga.isEmpty():
54 |             continue
55 | 
56 |         candidate_ids = set(index_b.intersects(ga.boundingBox()))
57 |         if not candidate_ids:
58 |             continue
59 | 
60 |         # Para recuperar só os candidatos, fazemos um loop em B e filtramos por id.
61 |         # (Mantém o exemplo alinhado ao Cookbook, que mostra o index retornando IDs)
62 |         for fb in layer_b.getFeatures():
63 |             if fb.id() not in candidate_ids:
64 |                 continue
65 | 
66 |             gb = fb.geometry()
67 |             if not gb or gb.isEmpty():
68 |                 continue
69 | 
70 |             # Predicado/operador GEOS (Cookbook cita intersects() como predicate)
71 |             # :contentReference[oaicite:20]{index=20}
72 |             if not ga.intersects(gb):
73 |                 continue
74 | 
75 |             inter = ga.intersection(gb)
76 |             if not inter or inter.isEmpty():
77 |                 continue
78 | 
79 |             perim_m = float(d.measurePerimeter(inter))
80 |             area_m2 = float(d.measureArea(inter))
81 |             area_ha = area_m2 / 10000.0
82 | 
83 |             f_out = QgsFeature(out_layer.fields())
84 |             f_out.setGeometry(inter)
85 |             f_out.setAttributes([area_m2, area_ha, perim_m])
86 |             out_feats.append(f_out)
87 | 
88 |     pr.addFeatures(out_feats)
89 |     out_layer.updateExtents()
90 | 
91 |     return out_layer

39 | def merge_layers_to_temp(layers: List[QgsVectorLayer],
40 |                          merge_name: str = "merged_temp") -> Tuple[Optional[QgsVectorLayer], Optional[str]]:
41 |     """
42 |     Merge multiple layers into temporary memory layer with source tracking
43 |     """
44 |     if not layers:
45 |         return None, tr("No layers provided")
46 |     
47 |     if len(layers) == 1:
48 |         return layers[0], None
49 |     
50 |     try:
51 |         ok, msg = check_layers_compatibility(layers)
52 |         if not ok:
53 |             return None, msg
54 |         
55 |         # Find common fields
56 |         common_fields = None
57 |         for layer in layers:
58 |             layer_field_dict = {field.name(): field.type() for field in layer.fields()}
59 |             if common_fields is None:
60 |                 common_fields = layer_field_dict
61 |             else:
62 |                 common_fields = {name: ftype for name, ftype in common_fields.items()
63 |                                 if name in layer_field_dict and layer_field_dict[name] == ftype}
64 |         
65 |         if not common_fields:
66 |             return None, tr("No common fields found")
67 |         
68 |         # Create temporary memory layer
69 |         first_layer = layers[0]
70 |         crs = first_layer.crs()
71 |         wkb_type = first_layer.wkbType()
72 |         uri = f"{QgsWkbTypes.displayString(wkb_type)}?crs={crs.authid()}"
73 |         temp_layer = QgsVectorLayer(uri, merge_name, "memory")
74 |         
75 |         if not temp_layer.isValid():
76 |             return None, tr("Unable to create temporary layer")
77 |         
78 |         provider = temp_layer.dataProvider()
79 |         
80 |         # Add common fields + source tracking
81 |         fields_to_add = []
82 |         for field_name in sorted(common_fields.keys()):
83 |             for layer in layers:
84 |                 field = layer.fields().field(field_name)
85 |                 if field:
86 |                     fields_to_add.append(field)
87 |                     break
88 |         fields_to_add.append(QgsField("__source_layer_id", QVariant.String))
89 |         fields_to_add.append(QgsField("__source_layer_name", QVariant.String))
90 |         provider.addAttributes(fields_to_add)
91 |         temp_layer.updateFields()
92 |         
93 |         # Merge features
94 |         all_features = []
95 |         for source_layer in layers:
96 |             source_layer_id = source_layer.id()
97 |             source_layer_name = source_layer.name()
98 |             
99 |             for feature in source_layer.getFeatures():
100 |                 if feature.geometry() is None or feature.geometry().isEmpty():
101 |                     continue
102 |                 
103 |                 new_feat = QgsFeature(temp_layer.fields())
104 |                 
105 |                 # Copy common attributes
106 |                 for field_name in common_fields.keys():
107 |                     try:
108 |                         idx = temp_layer.fields().indexOf(field_name)
109 |                         if idx >= 0:
110 |                             new_feat.setAttribute(idx, feature[field_name])
111 |                     except:
112 |                         pass
113 |                 
114 |                 # Add source tracking
115 |                 tracer_idx = temp_layer.fields().indexOf("__source_layer_id")
116 |                 name_idx = temp_layer.fields().indexOf("__source_layer_name")
117 |                 if tracer_idx >= 0:
118 |                     new_feat.setAttribute(tracer_idx, source_layer_id)
119 |                 if name_idx >= 0:
120 |                     new_feat.setAttribute(name_idx, source_layer_name)
121 |                 
122 |                 new_feat.setGeometry(feature.geometry())
123 |                 all_features.append(new_feat)
124 |         
125 |         if not all_features:
126 |             return None, tr("No valid features to merge")
127 |         
128 |         provider.addFeatures(all_features)
129 |         temp_layer.updateExtents()
130 |         
131 |         # Track for cleanup
132 |         TempLayerTracker.track_layer(temp_layer.id())
133 |         
134 |         return temp_layer, None
135 |         
136 |     except Exception as e:
137 |         log_message('error', f"Merge error: {e}", e)
138 |         return None, tr("Merge error: {}").format(str(e))

533 |     def gerar_camadas_pontos(self, exploded_layer, original_layer):
534 |         """
535 |         Gera uma nova camada de pontos a partir de uma camada de linhas explodida, coletando os valores de elevação
536 |         (cotas) do raster para os vértices inicial e final de cada segmento de linha. Adiciona os valores de elevação
537 |         à camada de pontos e calcula a inclinação para a camada de linhas explodida.
538 | 
539 |         Parâmetros:
540 |         - self: Referência para a instância atual da classe (implícito), utilizada para acessar os atributos e métodos da classe.
541 |         - exploded_layer (QgsVectorLayer): A camada de linhas explodida, onde cada segmento de linha será processado para obter
542 |           os valores de elevação (cotas) de seus pontos.
543 |         - original_layer (QgsVectorLayer): A camada de linhas original, usada para referência.
544 | 
545 |         A função realiza as seguintes ações:
546 |         - Obtém a camada raster atualmente selecionada no ComboBox de Raster.
547 |         - Verifica se a camada raster é válida e é do tipo QgsRasterLayer.
548 |         - Cria uma nova camada de pontos com o mesmo sistema de referência da camada de linhas explodida.
549 |         - Adiciona os pontos correspondentes aos vértices inicial e final de cada segmento de linha à nova camada de pontos,
550 |           coletando os valores de elevação do raster no ponto inicial e final.
551 |         - Armazena as cotas (elevação) dos pontos no dicionário 'cota_inicial_final' para posterior cálculo da inclinação.
552 |         - Calcula a inclinação da camada de linhas explodida chamando a função '_calcular_inclinacao'.
553 | 
554 |         Retorno:
555 |         - Nenhum retorno explícito. A função adiciona diretamente a camada de pontos ao projeto e atualiza a camada de linhas
556 |           explodida com a inclinação calculada.
557 |         """
558 | 
559 |         # Obtém o ID da camada raster selecionada no comboBoxRaster
560 |         selected_raster_id = self.comboBoxRaster.currentData()
561 |         # Busca a camada raster no projeto pelo seu ID
562 |         selected_raster = QgsProject.instance().mapLayer(selected_raster_id)
563 | 
564 |         # Verifica se a camada raster selecionada é válida e se é do tipo QgsRasterLayer
565 |         if not selected_raster or not isinstance(selected_raster, QgsRasterLayer):
566 |             self.mostrar_mensagem("Nenhuma camada raster válida foi selecionada", "Erro")
567 |             return
568 | 
569 |         # Cria a nova camada de pontos com o mesmo SRC da camada de linhas explodida
570 |         point_layer = QgsVectorLayer(f"Point?crs={exploded_layer.crs().authid()}", f"{exploded_layer.name()}_points", "memory")
571 |         point_layer_data = point_layer.dataProvider()
572 | 
573 |         # Adiciona o campo "ValorRaster" à camada de pontos
574 |         point_layer_data.addAttributes([
575 |             QgsField("ID", QVariant.Int),
576 |             QgsField("ValorRaster", QVariant.Double)
577 |         ])
578 |         point_layer.updateFields()
579 | 
580 |         # Dicionário para armazenar as cotas dos pontos iniciais e finais por segmento de linha
581 |         cota_inicial_final = {}
582 | 
583 |         point_id = 1
584 |         for feature in exploded_layer.getFeatures():
585 |             geom = feature.geometry()
586 |             if geom:
587 |                 vertices = list(geom.vertices())
588 |                 if len(vertices) >= 2:
589 |                     # Converte o primeiro e último vértice de QgsPoint para QgsPointXY
590 |                     start_vertex_xy = QgsPointXY(vertices[0])
591 |                     end_vertex_xy = QgsPointXY(vertices[-1])
592 | 
593 |                     # Coleta a cota do MDT no ponto inicial
594 |                     ident_start = selected_raster.dataProvider().identify(start_vertex_xy, QgsRaster.IdentifyFormatValue)
595 |                     cota_start = ident_start.results().get(1, None)
596 | 
597 |                     # Coleta a cota do MDT no ponto final
598 |                     ident_end = selected_raster.dataProvider().identify(end_vertex_xy, QgsRaster.IdentifyFormatValue)
599 |                     cota_end = ident_end.results().get(1, None)
600 | 
601 |                     # Armazena as cotas no dicionário
602 |                     cota_inicial_final[feature.id()] = (cota_start, cota_end)
603 | 
604 |                     # Cria as feições de pontos e as adiciona à camada de pontos
605 |                     for vertex_xy, cota in [(start_vertex_xy, cota_start), (end_vertex_xy, cota_end)]:
606 |                         point_feat = QgsFeature(point_layer.fields())
607 |                         point_geom = QgsGeometry.fromPointXY(vertex_xy)
608 |                         point_feat.setGeometry(point_geom)
609 |                         point_feat.setAttributes([point_id, cota])
610 |                         point_layer_data.addFeature(point_feat)
611 |                         point_id += 1
612 | 
613 |         # Adiciona a nova camada de pontos ao projeto

615 |

52 |     """
53 |     Description
54 |     ----------
55 |     Builds regular grid of n lines and m columns, from QgsRectangle bbox.
56 |     Resulting features are appended to vprovider
57 | 
58 |     Parameters
59 |     ----------
60 |     input_feat : Qgis feature whose bounding box will be used to define the extents of the grid.
61 |                 It can be generated by QgsRectangle()
62 |     n, m      : number of rows and columns of output grid, respectively
63 |     vprovider : Qgis vector provider to which the output grid will be appended
64 | 
65 |     Returns
66 |     -------
67 | 
68 |     List of feature ids in the grid
69 | 
70 |     Examples
71 |     --------
72 |     >>>
73 |     """
74 | 
75 |     # Retrieve bbox and attributes from input feature
76 |     bbox = input_feat.geometry().boundingBox()
77 |     attr = input_feat.attributes()
78 | 
79 |     # Compute grid coordinates
80 |     x = np.linspace(bbox.xMinimum(), bbox.xMaximum(), m+1)
81 |     y = np.linspace(bbox.yMinimum(), bbox.yMaximum(), n+1)
82 |     xx, yy = np.meshgrid(x, y)
83 | 
84 |     # Initialize progress bar
85 |     if progress_bar is not None : 
86 |         progress_bar.setRange(0,100)
87 |         progress_bar.setValue(0)
88 |     count = 0
89 |     countMax = n*m
90 |     countUpdate = countMax * 0.05 # update each 5%
91 | 
92 |     # Initialize feature output list
93 |     out_feat_list = []
94 | 
95 |     # iterate over grid lines
96 |     for i in range(len(y)-1):
97 |         # iterate over grid columns
98 |         for j in range(len(x)-1):
99 |             # compute feature coordinate
100 |             # clock-wise point numbering (top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left)
101 |             # i for lines (top to bottom), j for columns (left to right)
102 |             x1, x2, x3, x4 = xx[i+1,j],  xx[i+1,j+1],  xx[i,j+1],  xx[i,j]
103 |             y1, y2, y3, y4 = yy[i+1,j],  yy[i+1,j+1],  yy[i,j+1],  yy[i,j]
104 |             # define feature points
105 |             pt1, pt2, pt3, pt4 =  QgsPointXY(x1, y1), QgsPointXY(x2, y2), QgsPointXY(x3, y3), QgsPointXY(x4, y4)
106 |             pt5 = pt1
107 |             # define polygon from points
108 |             polygon = [[pt1, pt2, pt3, pt4, pt5]]
109 |             # initialize new feature
110 |             out_feat = QgsFeature()
111 |             out_feat.setAttributes(attr)
112 |             out_geom = QgsGeometry()
113 |             out_feat.setGeometry(out_geom.fromPolygonXY(polygon))
114 |             # save features
115 |             out_feat_list.append(out_feat)
116 |             # update counter
117 |             count += 1
118 |             # update ID (TO DO : check numbering)
119 |             #idvar = count
120 |             # each 5%, update progress bar
121 |             if int( np.fmod( count, countUpdate ) ) == 0:
122 |                     prog = int( count / countMax * 100 )
123 |                     if progress_bar is not None : 
124 |                         progress_bar.setValue(prog)
125 |                     QApplication.processEvents()
126 | 
127 |     if progress_bar is not None : 
128 |         progress_bar.setValue(100)
129 |     # Check type of vector provider
130 |     # If vprovider is a layer provider
131 |     if repr(QgsVectorDataProvider) == str(type(vprovider)):
132 |         isFeatureAddSuccessful, newFeatures = vprovider.addFeatures(out_feat_list)
133 |         return([feat.id() for feat in newFeatures])
134 | 
135 |     # Else, if provider is a writer

80 | def transform_layer(l, crs_dst, datatype='polygon', wrap=False):
81 |     log('Transforming layer from "{}" to "{}". Wrap is {}. Datatype is {}.'.format(l.crs().toProj(), crs_dst.toProj(), wrap, datatype))
82 | 
83 |     crs_src_string = l.crs().toProj()
84 |     if wrap:
85 |         if not l.crs().isGeographic():
86 |             QtWidgets.QMessageBox.critical(None,tr_calculate.tr("Error"),
87 |                    tr_calculate.tr("Error - layer is not in a geographic coordinate system. Cannot wrap layer across 180th meridian."))
88 |             log('Can\'t wrap layer in non-geographic coordinate system: "{}"'.format(crs_src_string))
89 |             return None
90 |         crs_src_string = crs_src_string + ' +lon_wrap=180'
91 |     crs_src = QgsCoordinateReferenceSystem()
92 |     crs_src.createFromProj(crs_src_string)
93 |     t = QgsCoordinateTransform(crs_src, crs_dst, QgsProject.instance())
94 | 
95 |     l_w = QgsVectorLayer("{datatype}?crs=proj4:{crs}".format(datatype=datatype, 
96 |                          crs=crs_dst.toProj()), "calculation boundary (transformed)",  
97 |                          "memory")
98 |     feats = []
99 |     for f in l.getFeatures():
100 |         geom = f.geometry()
101 |         if wrap:
102 |             n = 0
103 |             p = geom.vertexAt(n)
104 |             # Note vertexAt returns QgsPointXY(0, 0) on error
105 |             while p != QgsPointXY(0, 0):
106 |                 if p.x() < 0:
107 |                     geom.moveVertex(p.x() + 360, p.y(), n)
108 |                 n += 1
109 |                 p = geom.vertexAt(n)
110 |         geom.transform(t)
111 |         f.setGeometry(geom)
112 |         feats.append(f)
113 |     l_w.dataProvider().addFeatures(feats)
114 |     l_w.commitChanges()
115 |     if not l_w.isValid():
116 |         log('Error transforming layer from "{}" to "{}" (wrap is {})'.format(crs_src_string, crs_dst.toProj(), wrap))
117 |         return None
118 |     else:
119 |         return l_w

78 |         """
79 |         Cria uma nova camada em memória reprojetada.
80 |         """
81 | 
82 |         if not layer or not layer.isValid():
83 |             return None
84 | 
85 |         if not target_crs or not target_crs.isValid():
86 |             return None
87 | 
88 |         source_crs = layer.crs()

91 |             return layer
92 | 
93 |         uri = f"{layer.wkbType()}?crs={target_crs.authid()}"

95 | 
96 |         provider = new_layer.dataProvider()
97 |         provider.addAttributes(layer.fields())
98 |         new_layer.updateFields()
99 | 
100 |         transform = QgsCoordinateTransform(
101 |             source_crs,
102 |             target_crs,
103 |             QgsProject.instance().transformContext()
104 |         )
105 | 
106 |         feats = []
107 | 
108 |         for feat in layer.getFeatures():
109 |             new_feat = QgsFeature(layer.fields())

111 | 
112 |             geom = feat.geometry()
113 |             if geom and not geom.isEmpty():

121 |         new_layer.updateExtents()
122 |

871 |     def processar_cotas_poligonos(self, raster_layer, estilizar=False, atribuir=False):
872 |         """
873 |         Processa uma camada raster para extrair cotas em polígonos e cria uma camada de polígonos no QGIS,
874 |         utilizando leitura em bloco para maior desempenho.
875 | 
876 |         Passos detalhados:
877 |         1. Captura o tempo de início do processo.
878 |         2. Obtém o provedor de dados, extensão e dimensões do raster.
879 |         3. Cria uma camada de polígonos temporária ("memory") com campos "ID" e "Value".
880 |         4. Calcula o tamanho do pixel (resolução em X e Y).
881 |         5. Cria e exibe a barra de progresso.
882 |         6. Lê todos os valores da banda do raster de uma só vez usando block(), armazenando-os em um QgsRasterBlock.
883 |         7. Para cada pixel do raster:
884 |             a. Atualiza a barra de progresso a cada 1000 pixels.
885 |             b. Obtém o valor do pixel a partir do bloco.
886 |             c. Ignora pixels nulos (NoData ou NaN).
887 |             d. Calcula os limites do pixel (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax).
888 |             e. Cria um polígono (retângulo) correspondente ao pixel.
889 |             f. Cria a feature, atribui ID e valor do pixel, e armazena numa lista.
890 |             g. Adiciona o valor do pixel na lista para possíveis graduações.
891 |         8. Adiciona todas as features à camada de uma só vez.
892 |         9. Adiciona a camada de polígonos ao projeto QGIS.
893 |         10. Obtém ou gera a colormap, e aplica o estilo graduado se solicitado.
894 |         11. Aplica estilo de atribuição se solicitado.
895 |         12. Atualiza a barra de progresso para 100%.
896 |         13. Calcula e exibe o tempo total de execução.
897 |         14. Remove a barra de progresso da interface.
898 |         """
899 |         start_time = time.time()  # 1. Tempo de início
900 | 
901 |         # 2. Informações do raster
902 |         provider = raster_layer.dataProvider()
903 |         extent = provider.extent()
904 |         width = provider.xSize()
905 |         height = provider.ySize()
906 |         band = 1
907 | 
908 |         # 3. Cria camada de polígonos com nome único e campos
909 |         camada_poligono = self.criar_camadas_poligonos_unicas(raster_layer)
910 |         pr = camada_poligono.dataProvider()
911 |         pr.addAttributes([QgsField("ID", QMetaType.Type.Int), QgsField("Value", QMetaType.Type.Double)])
912 |         camada_poligono.updateFields()
913 | 
914 |         # 4. Resolução do pixel
915 |         pixelSizeX = extent.width() / width
916 |         pixelSizeY = extent.height() / height
917 | 
918 |         # 5. Barra de progresso
919 |         total_steps = width * height
920 |         progress_bar, progress_message_bar = self.iniciar_progress_bar(total_steps)
921 | 
922 |         # 6. Lê bloco inteiro do raster
923 |         raster_block = provider.block(band, extent, width, height)
924 | 
925 |         features = []
926 |         valores_pixel = []
927 |         id_count = 0
928 |         update_interval = 1000
929 | 
930 |         # 7. Loop para todos os pixels
931 |         for row in range(height):
932 |             for col in range(width):
933 |                 id_count += 1
934 | 
935 |                 # 7a. Atualiza barra de progresso periodicamente
936 |                 if id_count % update_interval == 0:
937 |                     progress_bar.setValue(id_count)
938 | 
939 |                 # 7b. Valor do pixel a partir do bloco
940 |                 valor_pixel = raster_block.value(row, col)
941 |                 if valor_pixel is None or valor_pixel != valor_pixel:  # 7c. Ignora NoData/NaN
942 |                     continue
943 | 
944 |                 # 7d. Limites do pixel (retângulo)
945 |                 xMin = extent.xMinimum() + col * pixelSizeX
946 |                 xMax = extent.xMinimum() + (col + 1) * pixelSizeX
947 |                 yMax = extent.yMaximum() - row * pixelSizeY
948 |                 yMin = extent.yMaximum() - (row + 1) * pixelSizeY
949 | 
950 |                 # 7e. Cria polígono retângulo do pixel
951 |                 poligono = QgsGeometry.fromRect(QgsRectangle(xMin, yMin, xMax, yMax))
952 | 
953 |                 # 7f. Cria feature, define geometria e atributos
954 |                 feature = QgsFeature()
955 |                 feature.setGeometry(poligono)
956 |                 feature.setAttributes([id_count, valor_pixel])
957 |                 features.append(feature)
958 | 
959 |                 # 7g. Armazena valor do pixel
960 |                 valores_pixel.append(valor_pixel)
961 | 
962 |         # 8. Adiciona todas features de uma só vez
963 |         pr.addFeatures(features)
964 |         camada_poligono.updateExtents()
965 | 
966 |         # 9. Adiciona camada ao projeto
967 |         QgsProject.instance().addMapLayer(camada_poligono)
968 | 
969 |         # 10. Obtém ou gera colormap e aplica estilo graduado se necessário
970 |         renderer = raster_layer.renderer()
971 |         colormap = []
972 |         if hasattr(renderer, 'shader'):
973 |             shader = renderer.shader()
974 |             color_ramp_shader = shader.rasterShaderFunction()
975 |             if isinstance(color_ramp_shader, QgsColorRampShader):
976 |                 colormap = color_ramp_shader.colorRampItemList()
977 |

981 |             max_value = max(valores_pixel)
982 |             colormap = self.gerar_colormap_cinza(min_value, max_value, 10)

989 | 
990 |         # 12. Atualiza barra de progresso para 100%
991 |         progress_bar.setValue(total_steps)
992 | 
993 |         # 13. Tempo de execução

998 |         self.mostrar_mensagem(

109 |

111 |             out.setAttributes(

113 |                     # sec_id

117 |                     if self.name_field

347 |     def reorder_fields_alphabetically(layer):
348 |         """
349 |         Cria uma nova layer com campos reordenados em ordem alfabética (case-insensitive).
350 |         Compatível com QGIS 3.16+.
351 |         
352 |         A ordenação segue o padrão key=str.lower:
353 |         - Case-insensitive: 'A' e 'a' na mesma sequência
354 |         - Números e símbolos vêm antes das letras (ordem ASCII)
355 |         - 'abacate', 'Alicate', 'arcelga': 'abacate' -> 'Alicate' -> 'arcelga'
356 |         
357 |         Parameters
358 |         ----------
359 |         layer : QgsVectorLayer
360 |             Camada vetorial fonte
361 | 
362 |         Returns
363 |         -------
364 |         QgsVectorLayer or None
365 |             Nova layer com campos ordenados, ou None em caso de erro
366 |         """
367 |         logger = LogUtils(tool="untraceable", class_name="VectorLayerAttributes")
368 |         if not layer or not layer.isValid():
369 |             logger.error("Camada inválida para reordenar campos")
370 |             return None
371 | 
372 |         fields = layer.fields()
373 |         if fields.count() <= 1:
374 |             return layer
375 | 
376 |         field_names = [field.name() for field in fields]
377 |         sorted_names = sorted(field_names, key=lambda x: str(x).lower())
378 | 
379 |         if sorted_names == field_names:
380 |             return layer
381 | 
382 |         try:
383 |             # 1. Construir QgsFields na ordem alfabética
384 |             new_fields = QgsFields()
385 |             for name in sorted_names:
386 |                 idx = fields.lookupField(name)
387 |                 if idx != -1:
388 |                     new_fields.append(fields.at(idx))
389 |             if new_fields.count() != fields.count():
390 |                 logger.error("Contagem de campos não corresponde após reordenação")
391 |                 return None
392 | 
393 |             # 2. Criar nova camada em memória com os campos ordenados
394 |             wkb_type = layer.wkbType()
395 |             crs = layer.crs()
396 |             geom_type = QgsWkbTypes.displayString(wkb_type)
397 |             new_uri = f"{geom_type}?crs={crs.authid()}"
398 |             new_layer = QgsVectorLayer(new_uri, layer.name(), "memory")
399 |             new_prov = new_layer.dataProvider()
400 |             new_prov.addAttributes(new_fields)
401 |             new_layer.updateFields()
402 | 
403 |             # 3. Copiar features com atributos mapeados para a nova ordem
404 |             new_layer.startEditing()
405 |             for feat in layer.getFeatures():
406 |                 new_feat = QgsFeature(new_fields)
407 |                 new_feat.setGeometry(feat.geometry())

409 |                 for field_name in sorted_names:

411 |                     if attr_idx != -1:
412 |                         new_feat[field_name] = feat.attributes()[attr_idx]
413 |                 new_layer.addFeature(new_feat)

11 | def add_hooks_to_lines(layer_name, hook_length=30, hook_angle_deg=135):
12 |     # Get the input layer
13 |     input_layer = QgsProject.instance().mapLayersByName(layer_name)[0]
14 |     if not input_layer:
15 |         raise Exception(f"Layer '{layer_name}' not found.")
16 | 
17 |     # Create memory output layer
18 |     output_layer = QgsVectorLayer(
19 |         "LineString?crs=" + input_layer.crs().authid(), "hooked_lines", "memory"
20 |     )
21 |     output_layer.dataProvider().addAttributes(input_layer.fields())
22 |     output_layer.updateFields()
23 | 
24 |     # Convert degrees to radians
25 |     angle_rad = math.radians(hook_angle_deg)
26 | 
27 |     for feature in input_layer.getFeatures():
28 |         geom = feature.geometry()
29 |         if not geom or geom.isEmpty() or geom.type() != QgsWkbTypes.LineGeometry:
30 |             continue
31 | 
32 |         points = geom.asPolyline()
33 |         if len(points) != 2:
34 |             continue  # Only works for straight 2-point lines
35 | 
36 |         p1 = points[0]
37 |         p2 = points[1]
38 | 
39 |         # Vector from p1 to p2
40 |         dx = p2.x() - p1.x()
41 |         dy = p2.y() - p1.y()
42 |         length = math.hypot(dx, dy)
43 |         if length == 0:
44 |             continue
45 | 
46 |         # Unit vector from p1 to p2
47 |         ux = dx / length
48 |         uy = dy / length
49 | 
50 |         # === Start Hook ===
51 |         # Rotate vector by +135°
52 |         cos_a = math.cos(angle_rad)
53 |         sin_a = math.sin(angle_rad)
54 |         hook_dx1 = ux * cos_a - uy * sin_a
55 |         hook_dy1 = ux * sin_a + uy * cos_a
56 |         hx1 = p1.x() + hook_length * hook_dx1
57 |         hy1 = p1.y() + hook_length * hook_dy1
58 | 
59 |         # === End Hook ===
60 |         # Use reversed vector (-ux, -uy), then rotate by +135°
61 |         rev_ux = -ux
62 |         rev_uy = -uy
63 |         hook_dx2 = rev_ux * cos_a - rev_uy * sin_a
64 |         hook_dy2 = rev_ux * sin_a + rev_uy * cos_a
65 |         hx2 = p2.x() + hook_length * hook_dx2
66 |         hy2 = p2.y() + hook_length * hook_dy2
67 | 
68 |         # New geometry: hook → p1 → p2 → hook
69 |         new_geom = QgsGeometry.fromPolylineXY([
70 |             QgsPointXY(hx1, hy1),  # Hook at start
71 |             p1,
72 |             p2,
73 |             QgsPointXY(hx2, hy2)   # Hook at end
74 |         ])
75 | 
76 |         # Create and add new feature
77 |         new_feature = QgsFeature()
78 |         new_feature.setFields(output_layer.fields())
79 |         new_feature.setAttributes(feature.attributes())
80 |         new_feature.setGeometry(new_geom)
81 |         output_layer.dataProvider().addFeature(new_feature)
82 | 
83 |     output_layer.updateExtents()
84 |     QgsProject.instance().addMapLayer(output_layer)
85 |     print(" Z-shaped hooked lines created with correct mirrored angles.")

61 |                 if log_callback:
62 |                     log_callback(msg)
63 | 
64 |             # Reproyectar si EPSG destino es distinto

989 |     def _clip_layer_to_commune(self, layer, commune_layer, buffer_m=25):
990 |         """Filtre les entités d'une couche vectorielle selon l'emprise de la commune.
991 | 
992 |         Calcule un buffer (en mètres, en EPSG:2154) autour de la géométrie
993 |         communale, reprojette ce buffer dans le CRS de la couche cible, puis
994 |         ne conserve que les entités dont la géométrie intersecte ce buffer.
995 |         Le résultat est une couche mémoire qui remplace la couche originale
996 |         dans le projet QGIS.
997 | 
998 |         Args:
999 |             layer: QgsVectorLayer à filtrer (déjà chargée dans le projet)
1000 |             commune_layer: QgsVectorLayer contenant la géométrie de la commune
1001 |             buffer_m: rayon du buffer en mètres (défaut 25)
1002 | 
1003 |         Returns:
1004 |             QgsVectorLayer filtrée (couche mémoire), ou la couche originale
1005 |             si le clip échoue.
1006 |         """
1007 |         try:
1008 |             # 1. Fusionner les géométries de la couche commune
1009 |             geom_commune = None
1010 |             for feat in commune_layer.getFeatures():
1011 |                 g = feat.geometry()
1012 |                 if g and not g.isEmpty():
1013 |                     geom_commune = g if geom_commune is None else geom_commune.combine(g)
1014 | 
1015 |             if geom_commune is None or geom_commune.isEmpty():
1016 |                 QgsMessageLog.logMessage(
1017 |                     "Clip commune : géométrie communale vide, clip ignoré.",
1018 |                     "VoirieCommunale", Qgis.Warning
1019 |                 )
1020 |                 return layer
1021 | 
1022 |             # 2. Reprojeter la géométrie en EPSG:2154 pour le buffer métrique
1023 |             crs_2154 = QgsCoordinateReferenceSystem("EPSG:2154")
1024 |             crs_commune = commune_layer.crs()
1025 |             if crs_commune != crs_2154:
1026 |                 xform_to_2154 = QgsCoordinateTransform(
1027 |                     crs_commune, crs_2154, QgsProject.instance()
1028 |                 )
1029 |                 geom_2154 = QgsGeometry(geom_commune)
1030 |                 geom_2154.transform(xform_to_2154)
1031 |             else:
1032 |                 geom_2154 = geom_commune
1033 | 
1034 |             # 3. Appliquer le buffer en mètres
1035 |             mask_2154 = geom_2154.buffer(buffer_m, 25) if buffer_m > 0 else geom_2154
1036 | 
1037 |             # 4. Reprojeter le masque dans le CRS de la couche cible
1038 |             crs_layer = layer.crs()
1039 |             if crs_layer != crs_2154:
1040 |                 xform_to_layer = QgsCoordinateTransform(
1041 |                     crs_2154, crs_layer, QgsProject.instance()
1042 |                 )
1043 |                 mask = QgsGeometry(mask_2154)
1044 |                 mask.transform(xform_to_layer)
1045 |             else:
1046 |                 mask = mask_2154
1047 | 
1048 |             # 5. Filtrer les entités qui intersectent le masque
1049 |             kept_features = [
1050 |                 f for f in layer.getFeatures()
1051 |                 if f.geometry() and not f.geometry().isEmpty()
1052 |                 and f.geometry().intersects(mask)
1053 |             ]
1054 | 
1055 |             if not kept_features:
1056 |                 QgsMessageLog.logMessage(
1057 |                     f"Clip commune : aucune entité conservée pour la couche '{layer.name()}'.",
1058 |                     "VoirieCommunale", Qgis.Warning
1059 |                 )
1060 |                 return layer
1061 | 
1062 |             # 6. Créer une couche mémoire avec les entités filtrées
1063 |             # QgsWkbTypes.displayString() retourne "LineString", "MultiLineString", etc.
1064 |             # (contrairement à geometryDisplayString qui retourne "Line" — invalide pour le provider mémoire)

1066 |             crs_authid = crs_layer.authid()
1067 |             mem_layer = QgsVectorLayer(

1071 |             )
1072 |             if not mem_layer.isValid():
1073 |                 QgsMessageLog.logMessage(

1075 |                     "VoirieCommunale", Qgis.Warning
1076 |                 )

1078 |             mem_provider = mem_layer.dataProvider()

1082 |             mem_layer.updateExtents()
1083 |

157 |     def copy_filtered_to_memory(
158 |         self,
159 |         layer: QgsVectorLayer,
160 |         layer_name: str = "filtered_copy"
161 |     ) -> GeometryPreparationResult:
162 |         """
163 |         Copy filtered layer (with subset string) to memory layer.
164 | 
165 |         Creates a memory copy of only the visible features from a layer
166 |         that has an active subset string filter. This is essential for
167 |         algorithms that don't respect subset strings.
168 | 
169 |         STABILITY: Validates and optionally repairs geometries during copy
170 |         to prevent access violations from corrupted geometries.
171 | 
172 |         Args:
173 |             layer: Source layer (may have subset string)
174 |             layer_name: Name for memory layer
175 | 
176 |         Returns:
177 |             GeometryPreparationResult with memory layer
178 |         """
179 |         if not layer or not layer.isValid():
180 |             return GeometryPreparationResult(
181 |                 success=False,
182 |                 error_message="Invalid or None layer provided"
183 |             )
184 | 
185 |         subset_string = layer.subsetString()
186 |         feature_count = layer.featureCount()
187 |         is_virtual = layer.providerType() == 'virtual'
188 | 
189 |         logger.debug(
190 |             f"copy_filtered_to_memory: {layer.name()}, "
191 |             f"features={feature_count}, "
192 |             f"subset='{subset_string[:50] if subset_string else 'None'}'"
193 |         )
194 | 
195 |         # If no filter and reasonable count, return original (except virtual layers)
196 |         if not subset_string and feature_count < 10000 and not is_virtual:
197 |             logger.debug("No filter and small layer - returning original")
198 |             return GeometryPreparationResult(
199 |                 success=True,
200 |                 layer=layer,
201 |                 feature_count=feature_count
202 |             )
203 | 
204 |         if is_virtual:
205 |             logger.info("Virtual layer detected - copying to memory for stability")
206 | 
207 |         # Create memory layer with same structure
208 |         geom_type = QgsWkbTypes.displayString(layer.wkbType())
209 |         crs = layer.crs().authid()
210 |         memory_layer = QgsVectorLayer(
211 |             f"{geom_type}?crs={crs}",
212 |             layer_name,
213 |             "memory"
214 |         )
215 | 
216 |         if not memory_layer.isValid():
217 |             return GeometryPreparationResult(
218 |                 success=False,
219 |                 error_message=f"Failed to create memory layer: {geom_type}?crs={crs}"
220 |             )
221 | 
222 |         # Copy fields
223 |         memory_layer.dataProvider().addAttributes(layer.fields())
224 |         memory_layer.updateFields()
225 | 
226 |         # Copy features with optional validation
227 |         features_to_copy = []
228 |         skipped = 0
229 |         repaired = 0
230 | 
231 |         for feature in layer.getFeatures():
232 |             geom = feature.geometry()
233 | 
234 |             if self._config.validate_geometries and geom and not geom.isEmpty():
235 |                 if not geom.isGeosValid():
236 |                     if self._config.repair_geometries:
237 |                         repaired_geom = self._repair_geometry(geom)
238 |                         if repaired_geom and repaired_geom.isGeosValid():
239 |                             feature.setGeometry(repaired_geom)
240 |                             repaired += 1
241 |                         else:
242 |                             skipped += 1
243 |                             continue
244 |                     else:
245 |                         skipped += 1
246 |                         continue
247 | 
248 |             features_to_copy.append(feature)
249 | 
250 |         if repaired > 0:
251 |             logger.info(f"Repaired {repaired} invalid geometries during copy")
252 |         if skipped > 0:
253 |             logger.warning(f"Skipped {skipped} invalid geometries")
254 | 
255 |         if not features_to_copy:
256 |             return GeometryPreparationResult(
257 |                 success=False,
258 |                 error_message="No valid features to copy"
259 |             )
260 | 
261 |         memory_layer.dataProvider().addFeatures(features_to_copy)
262 |         memory_layer.updateExtents()
263 | 
264 |         self._metrics['layers_copied'] += 1
265 |         self._metrics['geometries_validated'] += len(features_to_copy) + skipped
266 |         self._metrics['geometries_repaired'] += repaired
267 | 
268 |         logger.debug(
269 |             f"Copied {len(features_to_copy)} features to memory "
270 |             f"(skipped {skipped}, repaired {repaired})"
271 |         )
272 | 
273 |         return GeometryPreparationResult(
274 |             success=True,
275 |             layer=memory_layer,
276 |             feature_count=len(features_to_copy),
277 |             valid_count=len(features_to_copy),
278 |             repaired_count=repaired
279 |         )

59 |                 if not nombre_original:
60 |                     msg = f"⚠️ {ruta_gpkg.stem}: capa sin nombre #{contador_sin_nombre} → omitida."

87 |                     if log_callback:

89 | 
90 |                 # Crear capa en memoria con geometría correcta

80 | def query_catasto_point(x, y, memory_layer):
81 |     """
82 |     Interroga il WFS del Catasto per un punto specificato e aggiunge i risultati al layer della sessione
83 |     Args:
84 |         x (float): Longitudine del punto (WGS84)
85 |         y (float): Latitudine del punto (WGS84)

89 |     
90 |     uri = (f"pagingEnabled='true' "
91 |            f"preferCoordinatesForWfsT11='false' "
92 |            f"restrictToRequestBBOX='1' "
93 |            f"srsname='EPSG:6706' "
94 |            f"typename='CP:CadastralParcel' "
95 |            f"url='{base_url}' "
96 |            f"version='2.0.0' "
97 |            f"language='ita'")
98 |     
99 |     print(f"\nInizio query per il punto ({x}, {y})")
100 |     
101 |     wfs_layer = QgsVectorLayer(uri, "catasto_query", "WFS")
102 |     
103 |     if not wfs_layer.isValid():
104 |         error_msg = wfs_layer.dataProvider().error().message() if wfs_layer.dataProvider() else "Nessun dettaglio disponibile"
105 |         raise Exception(f"Layer non valido. Dettagli: {error_msg}")
106 |     
107 |     print("Layer WFS caricato con successo")
108 |     
109 |     point = QgsGeometry.fromPointXY(QgsPointXY(x, y))

111 |     features = list(wfs_layer.getFeatures(request))

113 |     
114 |     if features:
115 |         # Se è la prima feature, inizializza i campi del layer
116 |         if memory_layer.fields().count() == 0:
117 |             memory_layer.addAttribute(QgsField('NATIONALCADASTRALREFERENCE', QVariant.String))
118 |             memory_layer.addAttribute(QgsField('ADMIN', QVariant.String))
119 |             memory_layer.addAttribute(QgsField('SEZIONE', QVariant.String))
120 |             memory_layer.addAttribute(QgsField('FOGLIO', QVariant.String))
121 |             memory_layer.addAttribute(QgsField('PARTICELLA', QVariant.String))
122 |             memory_layer.updateFields()
123 |         
124 |         # Aggiungi le features al layer della sessione
125 |         memory_layer.startEditing()
126 |         features_to_add = []
127 |         existing_refs = set(feat['NATIONALCADASTRALREFERENCE'] for feat in memory_layer.getFeatures())
128 |         
129 |         for feat in features:
130 |             ref_catastale = feat['NATIONALCADASTRALREFERENCE']
131 |             if ref_catastale not in existing_refs:
132 |                 new_feat = QgsFeature(memory_layer.fields())
133 |                 # Copia e elabora il riferimento catastale
134 |                 ref_catastale = feat['NATIONALCADASTRALREFERENCE']
135 |                 new_feat['NATIONALCADASTRALREFERENCE'] = ref_catastale
136 |                 
137 |                 # Estrai i componenti usando la regex
138 |                 new_feat['ADMIN'] = ref_catastale[:4]
139 |                 new_feat['SEZIONE'] = ref_catastale[4:5]
140 |                 new_feat['FOGLIO'] = ref_catastale[5:9]
141 |                 new_feat['PARTICELLA'] = ref_catastale.split('.')[-1]
142 |                 # Copia geometria
143 |                 new_feat.setGeometry(feat.geometry())
144 |                 features_to_add.append(new_feat)
145 |                 existing_refs.add(ref_catastale)
